summary.intent: Open a PR for the T09 routes work, then clean up the project plan docs by removing the shipped T09 and T09-ROUTES entries and stale rows.
summary.outcome: PR #249 was opened for the routes work. A follow-up docs-only PR was created from a fresh worktree on main that prunes the shipped T09 entries from ROAD-TO-V1.md, V1-FINDINGS.md, V1-IMPLEMENTATION.md and V1-SYSTEM-HARDENING.json, and CI passed.

repo: Plan docs live in docs/projects/ (ROAD-TO-V1.md, V1-FINDINGS.md, V1-IMPLEMENTATION.md, V1-SYSTEM-HARDENING.json) and all reference shipped task IDs like T09 and T09-ROUTES, so they must be pruned together.
V1-SYSTEM-HARDENING.json has batches, dependencies and a `reasoning` field that need checking before removing an entry.
Docs-only changes do not need a changeset in this repo.
CI can be run locally against a docs prune before committing.
workflow: Before hand-editing a JSON plan file, test that a parse/serialize round-trip is lossless (a trailing newline was needed) so the diff stays minimal.
Use a fresh worktree off main for the cleanup PR so it stays separate from the feature PR.
Verify each stale-entry claim against the actual files before deleting.
